dataset-integrity-guard.description: Prevents deletion/modification of protected assets (images/, datasets/, .env)

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '[Hook] Dataset integrity guard active — images/ and datasets/ are protected.'"

rtl-script-guard.description: Ensures Shahmukhi script is used for Punjabi, never Gurmukhi

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '[Hook] Verifying RTL script integrity for Punjabi/Shahmukhi.'"

api-token-guard.description: Prevents committing API keys or .env files to git

experiment-progress-tracker.description: Tracks experiment run progress and auto-checks results

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '[Hook] Experiment step complete. Auto-saving checkpoint.'"

python-validator.description: Validates Python syntax and imports after code changes

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '[Hook] Validating Python imports and syntax.'"

mcnemar-test-guard.description: Ensures McNemar test is used with p < 0.1, correction=False

hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Write-Output '[Hook] Statistical significance: McNemar test with p < 0.1, correction=False.'"

temp-guard.description: Enforces temp=0 and max_tokens=100 for non-reasoning regime
